# `vault/keyvault.ts` API Reference

## Overview

The `vault/keyvault.ts` module provides utilities for managing secrets in a key vault. It includes helpers for constructing standardized secret names as well as async functions for reading, writing, and deleting secrets by name.

---

## Exports

### `userSecretName`

Constructs a standardized secret name string for a given user, provider, and label.

```ts
import { userSecretName } from 'vault/keyvault';
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `userId` | `number` | The unique identifier of the user. |
| `provider` | `string` | The name of the provider associated with the secret. |
| `label` | `string` | A descriptive label for the secret. |

#### Returns

`string` — A formatted secret name derived from the provided arguments.

#### Example

```ts
const name = userSecretName(42, 'github', 'access-token');
```

---

### `getSecret`

Retrieves a secret value by name from the key vault.

```ts
import { getSecret } from 'vault/keyvault';
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `name` | `string` | The name of the secret to retrieve. |

#### Returns

`Promise<string | null>` — Resolves with the secret value if found, or `null` if the secret does not exist.

#### Example

```ts
const value = await getSecret('my-secret-name');
if (value !== null) {
  console.log('Secret retrieved:', value);
}
```

---

### `setSecret`

Creates or updates a secret in the key vault.

```ts
import { setSecret } from 'vault/keyvault';
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `name` | `string` | The name of the secret to set. |
| `value` | `string` | The value to store for the secret. |

#### Returns

`Promise<void>` — Resolves when the secret has been successfully written.

#### Example

```ts
await setSecret('my-secret-name', 'super-secret-value');
```

---

### `deleteSecret`

Permanently removes a secret from the key vault by name.

```ts
import { deleteSecret } from 'vault/keyvault';
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `name` | `string` | The name of the secret to delete. |

#### Returns

`Promise<void>` — Resolves when the secret has been successfully deleted.

#### Example

```ts
await deleteSecret('my-secret-name');
```
